title: CHGR Human Confirmation Evidence
description: Artifact classification: Evidentiary. Binds a confirmation to exact previewed content without capturing a real confirmation workflow this increment (Phase 143E) -- no create/preview/confirm command exists yet. Existence of a structurally valid instance never proves a confirmation actually occurred through a live interactive session (CHGR-REQ-089); it proves only that this evidentiary shape is well-formed.

confirmed_content_digest.description: Digest computed over the literal preview payload the human confirmed (CHGR-REQ-085). A HumanGovernanceRecord's confirmation is unbound (CONFIRMATION_UNBOUND) at verification if this digest does not match the record's own recomputed content digest.

preview_rendering_digest.description: Digest of the exact rendered preview shown before Confirmation (CHGR-REQ-047, CHGR-REQ-060).

confirmation_statement.description: The exact confirmation phrase or acknowledgement text the human confirmation act required (e.g. a typed confirmation phrase at L0). Never a paraphrase.

confirmer_identity_evidence.description: Identity evidence at the achieved assurance level only (CHGR-001 Sec.9). Never claims cryptographic identity this increment.

achieved_assurance_level.description: The assurance level this evidence shape actually supports. A HumanGovernanceRecord's own assurance_level SHALL NOT exceed this value (ASSURANCE_OVERCLAIM at verification if it does).

extensions.description: Controlled additive extension container, reserved for future stronger-assurance evidence variants (e.g. a signature) without altering this shape's existing meaning. Empty object permitted.
